title: Understanding k-Means Clustering
text: In k-Means clustering, each data point is assigned to the cluster whose center is closest to it. The distance is usually measured using the Euclidean distance formula.

title: Calculating Euclidean Distance
text: The Euclidean distance between two points (x1,y1) and (x2,y2) is calculated as $$\sqrt{\left(x2-x1\right)^2+\left(y2-y1\right)^2}$$.

hintAnswer: Distance to A: sqrt((5-0)**2+(4-5)**2)=sqrt(26), Distance to B: sqrt((5-6)**2+(4-0)**2)=sqrt(17)
